source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), Standard SCG add-on grip in its LEFT-hand version (SCG-L_For_GF_1200_03), seen from the rear left, front of the stick to the left: grip face, B1 on the outer (left) side, red trigger, edge of the white C1 on the right (thumb) side
mappingSource: catalog only (vkb.json: no factory numbering for the Standard, parts have no inputs; hat.1 is labelled 'A3 hat', the other two hats are unnumbered). Control identities from the product page https://vkbsimcontrollers.com/products/scg-add-on-grip-for-gunfighter-mk-iv-us (3 four-way hats with push, 4 buttons, dual-action trigger, no rapid-fire trigger, no ministick) and VKB's binding template "VKB Gunfighter SCG (LH)" v1.0 (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0808/7827/2731/files/VKB-Gunfighter-SCG-LH-v1.0.pdf, linked on https://vkbsimcontrollers.com/pages/downloads): A4 top-left hat, A1 top right, A3 centre, A2 red, B1 side, C1 thumb side, D1 pinky
note: The model is 'either' hand; this photo is the left-hand grip (mirror of the right). Many gallery photos (gallery-7..11, 17..21, 23, 24: SCG-L-P / SCG-R-P) show the PREMIUM grip with the rapid-fire lever, not this model; main is a Standard photo. The Standard's A1 is a 4-way hat (textured cap, no ministick). The catalog's 'second' and 'third' hats have no defined order, so A1 and A4 are kept as hidden candidates (map=low). 'Fourth button' = C1 by elimination (VKB spec: 4 buttons = A2, B1, C1, D1).
